description: This file defines a Summernote plugin for special characters, including UI components and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: makeSpecialCharSetTable
methods.description: Creates a table of special character buttons for selection.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin dialog with the special characters table.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the special characters dialog and inserts selected character.

methods.name: showSpecialCharDialog
methods.description: Handles the dialog UI and keyboard navigation for selecting special characters.
